headline: Devil's Gate Modern Oasis
articleBody:
Steep 1-acre canyon lot with 45' geometric lap pool, fire-water infinity feature, and suspended glass pavilion. Advanced geotechnical engineering stabilized unstable soils while preserving sycamore canopy.

Outcome: 17-week delivery. 30% property premium. California Landscape Contractors Association award. Private wellness retreats $60K/year revenue.
